hero.heading: Hi, I'm Michał. 👋 Frontend Engineer.
hero.first_paragraph: I create modern, responsive and functional frontend.

about.paragraph_first: I’m an experienced frontend engineer who develops scalable and user-friendly applications that help achieve companies' business goals. I consider myself a communicative and business-oriented person who not only codes but also provides business value and actively engages in discussions. I use AI tools on a daily basis to increase my productivity. If you're looking for someone who is not only an engineer but also a partner in your business, I'm the right person for you.
about.paragraph_second: After work, I like to spend time at the gym, walk or taste Asian cuisine.

offer.heading: Offer
offer.paragraph: I work on every project comprehensively and with the diligence I developed during my engineering studies. I adopt a personal approach to every collaboration. See what I can do for you and your business:

websites.title: Websites
websites.content: Responsive and based on modern technologies supporting SEO. Adjusted to the standards you set and your needs.

webApplications.title: Web applications
webApplications.content: Fully functional, meeting business requirements. Technologies adjusted to the project's needs.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.content: From A to Z: hosting, domain, SSL, deployment, maintenance and service, analytics, A/B tests.

emailTemplates.title: Email templates
emailTemplates.content: Responsive transactional and marketing emails. Adjusted to most available mailboxes.

mmc.1: Developed an interactive web app for learning foreign languages.
mmc.2: Optimized sites for Core Web Vitals.
mmc.3: Integrated websites with analytic tools, such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Hotjar.

signal.2: Built a cross-platform mobile application for parking space reservations.
signal.3: Executed field testing of EV charging infrastructure, validating critical charging scenarios and ensuring production readiness.

blazity.1: Built a no-code system for building RCS messages.
blazity.2: Developed an internal project estimation tool.

pirxey.1: Develop and maintain a large-scale generative AI chatbot platform serving over 6 million active users.
pirxey.2: Trusted by leadership to drive business-critical initiatives and deliver high-impact solutions aligned with company objectives.
pirxey.3: Own end-to-end delivery, from requirements analysis and technical design to release ownership and post-launch support.
pirxey.4: Act as a strategic partner to engineering and business leaders, helping shape priorities, challenge assumptions, and drive informed decisions.
pirxey.5: Apply a strong product mindset by identifying gaps in requirements, uncovering risks early, and ensuring solutions address real customer needs.
pirxey.6: Repeatedly acted as a frontend lead substitute, coordinating priorities and ensuring delivery continuity.
pirxey.7: Independently delivered an internal administration platform within two weeks, quickly ramping up without prior domain knowledge.

freelance.1: Delivered custom web solutions for small businesses, translating business requirements into scalable and user-friendly digital products.
freelance.2: Designed and developed a customer-facing website for a barbershop, including integration with the Przelewy24 payment platform.

waste-track-dashboard.title: Waste Track Dashboard
waste-track-dashboard.content: Dashboard for tracking waste management and generating AI-powered reports. Built entirely using AI spec-driven development.

dashboard.title: Admin Dashboard
dashboard.content: Classic admin dashboard with user authentication. User: sees revenues, expenses and users on charts, searches for specific orders.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce clothing store
ecommerce.content: Full-stack web application for buying clothes and shoes. User authentication and autorization: JWT. Caching backend data: React-Query. Payments: Stripe. User: selects size and color, manages basket, places an order.

finance.title: FINEances - finance manager
finance.content: Full-stack web application for managing your finances. User authentication: credentials, OAuth. User: adds, filters and groups earnings and spending, updates user profile.
